name: Snackbar
summary: A brief, transient message about a process or event, anchored to the bottom of the screen. It never blocks interaction and never requires a response; an action is optional.

inputs.name: message
inputs.description: The supporting text shown in the snackbar, one or two lines.

inputs.name: actionLabel
inputs.description: Label for the optional action button, e.g. "Undo" or "Retry". Omit for no action.

inputs.name: onAction
inputs.description: Runs when the action button is pressed. Dismisses the snackbar immediately regardless of its duration timer.

inputs.name: withDismissAction
inputs.description: Shows a trailing close icon that dismisses the snackbar immediately.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.description: Auto-dismiss duration. Default is short when actionLabel is absent, indefinite when it is present.

inputs.name: actionOnNewLine
inputs.description: Forces the action onto its own row below the text, switching to the two-line layout algorithm.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: The coloured surface the message sits on.

anatomy.name: Supporting text
anatomy.description: The message, one or two lines.

anatomy.name: Action
anatomy.description: A single text button, e.g. "Undo" or "Retry".

anatomy.name: Dismiss icon
anatomy.description: A close affordance at the trailing edge. Mutually exclusive, layout-wise, with the action button in the one-row single-line layout.

variants.description: Message fits one line and the action label is short enough to sit beside it, using comp.snackbar.single-line-container-height.
Message wraps to two lines, or the action label is long enough to force the button onto its own row below the text, using comp.snackbar.two-lines-container-height.

layout.text: Single-line vs. two-line is a layout algorithm choice, not a variant the caller declares: decide it from whether the action label plus text fit one row at the current width, not from counting characters.
Container width is capped at 600dp regardless of viewport; on wider screens the snackbar does not stretch full-bleed.
Horizontal inset from the screen edge to the container is 16dp; the side nearest a button gets 8dp instead.
Single-line layout: text gets 14dp vertical padding; when the action fits on the same row, the button sits 4dp from the container's bottom edge.
Two-line layout: the text's first line baseline sits 30dp from the top; the action row starts 12dp below the text baseline, with 2dp extra bottom padding under the button.
The dismiss icon, when present, always occupies its own trailing slot sized to icon-size; when there is no dismiss icon, the text gets 8dp of extra trailing space instead so it doesn't hug the edge.
Container height is the larger of the layout's height token and the measured content height — a large font can push a single-line container taller than single-line-container-height.
There is no hard-coded max-line clamp: Compose never truncates the text with an ellipsis. An implementor should still cap real messages at two lines editorially, since nothing in code enforces it.
comp.snackbar.container-elevation is applied as shadow elevation, not tonal — the container colour itself does not shift with elevation.

states.label: queued
states.text: Only one snackbar is ever visible at a time; a newly requested snackbar is queued and shown only once the current one has fully finished dismissing. There is no stacking of multiple visible snackbars.

behaviour.text: The container itself has no hover, focus or press state; only the action button and dismiss icon have interaction states, using their own button/icon-button specs.
Auto-dismiss after 4000ms when duration is short.
Auto-dismiss after 10000ms when duration is long.
Never auto-dismisses when duration is indefinite; requires the action or an explicit dismiss. Clicking the action or the dismiss icon dismisses immediately regardless of the timer.
Default duration is short when actionLabel is absent, indefinite when it is present — an actionable snackbar does not disappear on its own unless the caller overrides duration.

Enter and exit are a combined fade and scale, not a slide, despite the bottom-of-screen position: opacity animates 0 to 1 on fast-effects and scale animates 0.8 to 1.0 on fast-spatial, together in both directions. No slide offset is applied by the framework; placing the snackbar near the bottom edge (or above a FAB/nav bar) is the host's own layout responsibility.
Swipe-to-dismiss, mentioned in MDC-Android docs, is a host or gesture concern layered on top; it is not part of the Snackbar composable itself.

keyboard: Tab moves focus to the action button and dismiss icon when present; Enter or Space activates the focused one.
semantics: Announced via a live region tied to visibility, with a pane title read by screen readers; supporting text is read automatically, so don't duplicate it in a separate label.
Dismiss icon and action are real buttons; minimum touch target applies to both independent of their visual icon/text size.
A screen-reader-triggered dismiss action is exposed even without a visible dismiss icon, so assistive tech can always close a lingering (especially indefinite) snackbar.

notes.text: Because only one snackbar shows at a time and new ones queue silently, don't build a toast-stack visual with offset stacking or multiple partially-visible cards.
Indefinite snackbars are a trap without a visible dismiss affordance — pair a dismiss icon or action whenever duration is indefinite, or the message can only be cleared programmatically.
